newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Tuesday were not trading, with bids at $103.00 per cwt on a dressed basis being passed by owners pricing cattle at $105.00 to $106.00, market sources said.
There also were no trades reported on a live basis, with bids at $63.00 passed by owners asking $65.00, they said.

A storm overnight Monday left seven to 10 inches of wet snow from central to northeastern Nebraska, the sources said. The snow could slow performance at feedlots, but cattle were not expected to be overly stressed because temperatures were not seen dropping too low, they said.
